Jaime is a Senior Database Performance Engineer at Percona. Prior to joining Percona, Jaime worked as a remote system administrator managing high-traffic websites and consultant for several local companies. He also conducted Linux trainings in several schools. Jaime is based in the Philippines. He enjoys road trips and photography in his spare time.
